subject: ACE eligibility & go-to-market play: Neptune Analytics / PDM+PSM intro
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@neptuneanalytics.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: ACE eligibility & go-to-market play: Neptune Analytics / PDM+PSM intro

Hi Aisha — great to meet (virtually) and congrats on the interest in AWS ACE for Neptune Analytics. Per our intake call last week I wanted to do two quick things: 1) share an ACE eligibility checklist so your procurement/ops team can validate any gaps, and 2) introduce the Redwood PDM/PSM pair to align on a co-sell plan and listing assets.

At a high level we need to confirm the following before we submit the ACE registration:
- Marketplace listing owner (who will push the asset to AWS)
- SOC 2 / security artifacts (Aisha: you mentioned your security pack is up to date)
- Pricing guidance for an initial public listing (list price vs. co-sell pricing band)
- Mutual Action Plan (timeline for listing, joint webinars, PDM enablement)

Attachment: ACE-eligibility-checklist.pdf (short checklist + required artifacts).

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm procurement contact and whether Neptune wants back-to-back listing or private listing first.
- Kimberly (cc'd) is our Channel PM and will run the listing intake; Jonas (PDM) will join the intro to discuss GTM. Can we target a 30-minute sync this week? I am available Thu 10/22 10:00–11:30 PT or Fri 10/23 08:30–10:00 PT.

Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partner Manager, Cloud GTM | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@neptuneanalytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@neptuneanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE eligibility & go-to-market play: Neptune Analytics / PDM+PSM intro

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the checklist. Quick responses below: 

- Procurement: looping our procurement inbox (procurement@neptuneanalytics.com) — they handle contract + listing approvals.
- Security artifacts: we have a current SOC 2 Type II report and an internal data flow diagram; I can share a redacted folder by EOD.
- Listing owner: marketing will own the marketplace asset but procurement must sign off on commercial terms.
- Timeline: Neptune is targeting a soft listing by late Nov and a public go-live in early Dec (aligned to a product update).

We can do Thu 10/22 10:00 PT — that works for our GTM lead and product marketing. Please send a calendar invite with a brief agenda.

A couple of asks for the intro:
1) Can Redwood share a short MAP template so we can align milestones and who-owns-what?
2) We'd like to understand co-sell compensation bands and any program prerequisites (marketing assets, joint PR windows).

Looking forward — Aisha

--
Aisha Khan
Head of Partnerships, Neptune Analytics
aisha.khan@neptuneanalytics.com | +1 617-555-4558

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@neptuneanalytics.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE eligibility & go-to-market play: Neptune Analytics / PDM+PSM intro

Thanks — looping Jonas (PDM) and attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan to accelerate alignment. See the quick agenda for our 10/22 sync below.

Agenda (30 min)
- 0:00–0:05 Introductions & high-level objectives (Vanessa + Aisha)
- 0:05–0:12 Eligibility gaps / required artifacts (Kimberly)
- 0:12–0:22 PDM/PSM GTM alignment: go-to-market milestones, demo ownership, co-sell motions (Jonas)
- 0:22–0:28 Listing logistics & next milestones (who files the listing, timeline)
- 0:28–0:30 Action items & next steps

Attachment: Neptune-MAP-draft.xlsx (simple ownership/timeline matrix).

Pre-reads for the call: please have procurement confirm the billing entity and any reseller/marketplace approvals; Aisha, if you can share the SOC 2 redaction link before the call that's helpful.

I'll send the calendar invite for Thu 10/22 10:00 PT. If anything changes, ping me here.

Best,
Kimberly
Partner Program Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@neptuneanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE eligibility & go-to-market play: Neptune Analytics / PDM+PSM intro

Looks good — I'll join Thu and bring a short deck on co-sell signals we typically track and the PSM enablement checklist. A few technical asks so we can scope the support: 

- Can Neptune share an overview of typical inference latency and which APIs you expect to call? That informs the co-sell demo and any latency SLAs we may discuss.
- Do you expect to offer a managed instance on Neptune's infra or point customers to Redwood-hosted endpoints (this affects how we position the listing)?

I'll also bring the AWS ACE prerequisites we usually validate (SOC 2, DMZ/egress requirements, legal contact). If procurement prefers, we can route contract redlines through our legal queue and track in the MAP spreadsheet.

See you Thu 10/22 10:00 PT.

--
Jonas Weber
Product Development Manager (PDM) | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
